title: Dog Park (TV series)
premise_summary: Dog Park is an Australian dramatic comedy TV series made for ABC Television, released on 1 February 2026. Produced by Matchbox Pictures, the series focuses on Roland, who in the grip of a midlife crisis joins a group of dog owners in the local park.
